Copied from `runtime/composer/testdata/golden/` (composer 1.2.0, merged into ws/integration from ws/int-composer 2b54ee5): the fixture stack (llm-gateway + notes) the composer pins byte for byte. `golden.test.ts` boots the agent against this exact app-compose.json, so the agent and the composer agree on env names, measured configs, the ready directory, volumes, service IPs and the payment-needed Caddyfile. Refresh these files whenever the composer's golden files change.
